meta.title: Codex-inspired preset
meta.description: Lets the AI work like Codex: shell inspection, patch edits and one process per command.

approval.unsandboxed: Allow this command to run without the sandbox: {justification}

settings.title: Codex preset
settings.description: Free-form patches, visible tools and the project instruction budget for the Codex-inspired preset.
settings.freeformEnabledHint: Send apply_patch to matching models as a grammar tool instead of a JSON function.
settings.freeformCodexCatalogHint: Also enable the bridge for models the bundled Codex catalog marks as free-form.
settings.freeformRulesHint: One rule per line: provider:model, provider:, or :model. * matches any text. Empty keeps the preset row rules.
settings.surfaceAllowHint: Comma or space separated tool names that stay visible inside the preset, in addition to the surface row allow list.
settings.instructionsMaxBytesHint: Total UTF-8 budget for project instruction files, 1024 to 262144.
settings.saveFailed: The deployment did not accept these values. Correct them and save again.
settings.invalidNumber: Enter a whole number, or leave blank to use the default.
settings.unavailable: This plugin is not loaded, so it cannot be configured right now.
settings.reload: Saved values apply as soon as the form is saved, without restarting DSH.
